title: paraboea patens
intro: Paraboea patens, commonly known as the Sundew, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Gesneriaceae family. The Sundew plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive problems, due to its health benefits and therapeutic actions. The bioactive constituents of Paraboea patens include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties. While further research is needed to fully understand its potential, the Sundew plant has been traditionally used for its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities.
